sup:70740.subject: Part 370010 – 1.4404 bar: price basis and AS-14404 clause from 2027
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for your September letter proposing to agree the price basis together with an AS-14404 adjustment clause. We agree that both belong in one package, so we propose them together.

We want to give you the kind of volume and planning security your team has said it values. We are prepared to commit our authorised volume of 23,700 kg per year for part 370010 over a 36-month term from 1 January 2027. This is a stable, multi-year commitment at the stated annual volume. It does not include additional volume, exclusivity or a fixed monthly call-off schedule.

Our proposed package:
- Unit price: EUR 4.60/kg, DAP, 14-day lead time
- Payment: 60 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08

The 45% material share matches the AS-14404 cost share you stated in your quotation. With this clause, alloy movements in either direction pass through transparently, so the base price does not need to carry an alloy risk premium.

On the base price: we ordered from you on 2 and 17 June 2026 at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10). Our orders on 1 and 18 September 2026 were at EUR 5.84/kg (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Your quotation of EUR 6.10/kg would be a further step up from that level. With the alloy element now indexed, we need a clearly lower fixed base.

Does this package work for you? If not, which element would you need to adjust? We are keen to settle a clear, durable basis with you for the next three years.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 1.4404 bar: price basis and AS-14404 clause from 2027

To summarize, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for your September letter proposing to agree the price basis together with an AS-14404 adjustment clause. We agree that both belong in one package, so we propose them together.

We want to give you the kind of volume and planning security your team has said it values. We are prepared to commit our authorised volume of 23,700 kg per year for part 370010 over a 36-month term from 1 January 2027. This is a stable, multi-year commitment at the stated annual volume. It does not include additional volume, exclusivity or a fixed monthly call-off schedule.

Our proposed package:
- Unit price: EUR 4.60/kg, DAP, 14-day lead time
- Payment: 60 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08

The 45% material share matches the AS-14404 cost share you stated in your quotation. With this clause, alloy movements in either direction pass through transparently, so the base price does not need to carry an alloy risk premium.

On the base price: we ordered from you on 2 and 17 June 2026 at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10). Our orders on 1 and 18 September 2026 were at EUR 5.84/kg (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Your quotation of EUR 6.10/kg would be a further step up from that level. With the alloy element now indexed, we need a clearly lower fixed base.

Does this package work for you? If not, which element would you need to adjust? We are keen to settle a clear, durable basis with you for the next three years.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
